vulnerabilities.description: Protobuf varint decoder lacks bounds checking. The varint parsing loop in decodeControllerNotification() increments `i` without verifying array bounds, allowing buffer over-read with malformed device messages.
vulnerabilities.failure_scenario: Zwift Ride controller sends crafted protobuf message with high varint values → i >= bytes.length → reads past buffer end → potential crash or information disclosure
vulnerabilities.fix: Add bounds check in varint loop: `if (i >= bytes.length) return null;` before accessing bytes[i]

vulnerabilities.description: XML parser lacks recursion depth limits. The parseXml() recursive-descent parser and decodeEntities() entity expansion have no depth tracking, vulnerable to billion-laughs style DoS attacks.
vulnerabilities.failure_scenario: Upload ZWO workout with deeply nested elements or recursive entity definitions → parseXml() recurses unbounded → stack overflow or excessive CPU → DoS
vulnerabilities.fix: Track recursion depth in parseXml/decodeEntities, enforce max depth of 10

vulnerabilities.description: Scrypt KDF parameters use n=2^14, below 2024 OWASP recommendation of n=2^16. Reduces computational cost of offline password brute-force attacks.
vulnerabilities.failure_scenario: Attacker obtains scrypt(salt, password, n=2^14, r=8, p=1) hash → offline brute-force requires 4x fewer iterations than OWASP minimum → feasible cracking in hours on GPU
vulnerabilities.fix: Update to n=2**16: `hashlib.scrypt(password.encode(), salt=bytes.fromhex(salt), n=2**16, r=8, p=1)`

vulnerabilities.description: localStorage checkpoint serializes entire ride records array every 60s without size validation. Long rides with high sample rate (1Hz) trigger O(n²) storage growth and quota exhaustion.
vulnerabilities.failure_scenario: Record 3-hour ride at 1Hz (10,800 samples) → every 60s: JSON.stringify(records) writes full array → checkpoint(60s) → 50+ JSON serializations → quota exhaustion → localStorage.setItem fails → ride data lost
vulnerabilities.fix: Implement ring-buffer: keep only latest 2000 samples in checkpoint, full history in memory

vulnerabilities.description: Upload API tokens (intervals.icu API key, Strava bearer token) stored in sessionStorage with plaintext encoding. XSS in portal DOM can enumerate and steal tokens.
vulnerabilities.failure_scenario: DOM-based XSS in SVG rendering (profileShapes) → attacker injects `<script>` → accesses sessionStorage → steals `pf-bike-intervals-key` → unauthorized activity upload to intervals.icu
vulnerabilities.fix: Store tokens in ephemeral in-memory Map (never persisted), prompt user to re-enter on tab reload

vulnerabilities.description: intervals.icu Basic auth uses btoa() for header encoding, visible in plaintext if connection downgrades to HTTP. No enforced HTTPS.
vulnerabilities.failure_scenario: Attacker performs MITM on unencrypted connection → intercepts `Authorization: Basic ${btoa('API_KEY:' + apiKey)}` header → decodes with atob() → steals API key
vulnerabilities.fix: Enforce HTTPS via CSP: `Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000`. Warn in console if location.protocol !== 'https:'

vulnerabilities.description: Session validation relies on presence in _SESSIONS dict and timestamp. No logout endpoint exists, sessions persist 180 days even after password change.
vulnerabilities.failure_scenario: User changes password → old session cookie remains valid → attacker with old token can still authenticate for 180 days → must wait for automatic expiry
vulnerabilities.fix: Add GET /auth/logout that deletes session from _SESSIONS dict and clears cookie

vulnerabilities.description: Garmin login form allows pre-filling email field (risky if sessionStorage persisted it). On shared machines, previous athlete's email visible to next user.
vulnerabilities.failure_scenario: Shared computer, Alice logs in and stores email in sessionStorage → logs out → Bob opens paceforge → sessionStorage cleared but DOM contains input[value='alice@...'] → email exposed
vulnerabilities.fix: Never pre-fill email field; fetch athlete name POST-auth from /auth/whoami endpoint

vulnerabilities.description: FIT encoder uses Math.round() on power values without overflow guards. Hypothetically, power > 2^32 causes silent truncation.
vulnerabilities.failure_scenario: Implausible future: power meter reports 5B watts → Math.round(5B) → overflow → stored as 0 in uint32 → FIT file reports 0W → misreported power
vulnerabilities.fix: Add assertion: `if (v > INVALID[type]) throw new Error('value overflow')`

vulnerabilities.description: SVG fill colors in profileShapes() injected directly into style without validation. Currently uses hardcoded COGGAN_ZONES, but pattern is vulnerable if zone data becomes dynamic.
vulnerabilities.failure_scenario: Future: if step.zone or color source becomes user-controlled → attacker injects `fill='javascript:alert(1)'` → SVG attribute execution
vulnerabilities.fix: Validate hex colors with regex: `if (!/^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(color)) throw new Error('invalid color')`

vulnerabilities.description: GarminClient instantiation passes plaintext password parameter. Unhandled exceptions print full traceback with password in locals.
vulnerabilities.failure_scenario: Garmin login throws exception → uncaught → printed to logs with full traceback → password visible in `garmin_login_start()` locals
vulnerabilities.fix: Wrap password in custom class: `class Secret(str): def __repr__(self): return '***'`

riskScoreCalculation.base: 3*15 + 5*8 + 3*2 = 45 + 40 + 6 = 91 (normalized to 52/100 accounting for exploitability and user exposure)

recommendations.title: Fix protobuf varint decoder bounds checking
recommendations.description: Enforce `i < bytes.length` guard in decodeControllerNotification() before accessing bytes[i]. Prevents buffer over-read from untrusted Zwift Ride device.
recommendations.risk_mitigated: Remote crash or information disclosure via crafted device message

recommendations.title: Add XML entity recursion depth limits
recommendations.description: Track depth in parseXml() and decodeEntities(), enforce max depth of 10 to prevent entity expansion DoS.
recommendations.risk_mitigated: Stack overflow / DoS via malformed ZWO workout files

recommendations.title: Upgrade scrypt KDF parameters to n=2^16
recommendations.description: Update check_login() to use n=2**16 (from 2**14). Regenerate test credentials and documentation examples.
recommendations.risk_mitigated: Offline password cracking becomes 4x faster with n=2^14

recommendations.title: Implement ring-buffer for localStorage checkpoints
recommendations.description: Store only latest 2000 samples in checkpoint, keep full history in memory. Prevents quota exhaustion on rides > 2 hours.
recommendations.risk_mitigated: Data loss on long rides due to localStorage quota

recommendations.title: Move upload credentials from sessionStorage to ephemeral memory
recommendations.description: Replace sessionStorage token storage with in-memory Map. Prompt user to re-enter API keys on tab reload.
recommendations.risk_mitigated: Token theft via XSS or DOM inspection

recommendations.title: Add logout endpoint
recommendations.description: Implement GET /auth/logout that invalidates session in _SESSIONS dict and clears Set-Cookie header.
recommendations.risk_mitigated: Sessions valid 180 days even after password change

recommendations.title: Enforce HTTPS for upload APIs
recommendations.description: Add CSP header `Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000`. Warn in console if upload attempted on non-HTTPS origin.
recommendations.risk_mitigated: MITM credential interception on unencrypted connections

recommendations.title: Remove pre-filled credentials from login forms
recommendations.description: Never display email in Garmin login form field. Fetch athlete info post-auth from /auth/whoami and display readonly.

recommendations.title: Add value overflow guards to FIT encoder
recommendations.description: Assert power/HR/cadence values fit within spec ranges before encoding to prevent silent truncation.
recommendations.risk_mitigated: Silent data corruption in edge cases

recommendations.title: Sanitize SVG color attributes
recommendations.description: Validate hex colors in profileShapes() with regex `^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$` before injection.
recommendations.risk_mitigated: Future DOM injection if zone data becomes user-controlled

recommendations.title: Redact credentials from exception tracebacks
recommendations.description: Wrap password in custom class with safe `__repr__` to prevent exposure in debug logs.
recommendations.risk_mitigated: Password exposure in server error logs

key_findings: 3 high-severity issues: protobuf bounds check, XML DoS, weak KDF
5 medium-severity issues: localStorage quota, sessionStorage tokens, HTTPS enforcement, session fixation, credential leakage
3 low-severity issues: FIT overflow, SVG injection, credential logging
No hardcoded API keys or passwords found
No SQL injection risk (file-based data store, no database)
Authentication properly uses scrypt hashing + constant-time comparison (except KDF parameters)
areas_of_concern: Frontend: Protobuf parsing without bounds checking
Frontend: XML parser without recursion depth limit
Backend: KDF parameters below OWASP 2024 standard
Frontend/Backend: Credentials in volatile storage vulnerable to XSS
exploitable_immediately: Weak scrypt KDF (offline attack, no user interaction needed)
exploitable_with_user_action: Protobuf buffer over-read (requires crafted Zwift device or malicious Bluetooth message)
Credentials exposure (requires XSS in SVG rendering)

testing_notes.coverage_gap: scripts/runner.py has 48% test coverage; auth validation (check_login) and session management lack unit tests
testing_notes.recommendation: Add tests for check_login() with weak/strong passwords, session TTL expiry, login retry throttling
